name: BtnBuddy – Dynamic Floating Button
author: themeignite

sections.description:
Dynamic Floating Button is a flexible and user-friendly WordPress plugin that allows you to add floating buttons to your site for calls-to-action, social media, quick contact, cart, and more.

Designed for both beginners and developers, this plugin gives you complete control over the look and behavior of floating buttons using an intuitive admin interface.

Key Features

  • Custom Button Types: Create floating buttons for:

    • Call-to-Action (CTA)
    • Email/Phone
    • Shopping Cart or Checkout
    • User/Profile

  • Full Customization Options:

    • Add custom URLs
    • Choose button position (left, right)

  • Responsive & Lightweight:

    • Mobile-first design
    • Optimized loading with Bootstrap & Font Awesome
    • Clean admin UI for easy configuration

sections.installation:
Method 1: Install via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Login to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP or search for “Dynamic Floating Button”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Method 2: Installing via FTP

  1. Download the Plugin:

    • Download the Dynamic Floating Button plugin ZIP file from the [WordPress Plugin Repository].

  2. Extract the Plugin Files:

    • Extract the contents of the zip file to a folder on your computer.

  3. Upload the Plugin Files:

    • Connect to your website via FTP using an FTP client (e.g., FileZilla).
    • Navigate to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Upload the entire extracted dynamic-floating-button folder into the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  4. Activate the Plugin:

    • Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    • Navigate to “Plugins” in the left-hand menu.
    • Locate Dynamic Floating Button in the list and click the Activate link.

That’s it! Your floating buttons are ready to enhance your site’s engagement and user experience with just a few clicks.
